rules.input_description: identifier of a temporary working folder (a UUID)

stage_one: Only the two global byte substitutions; no other byte edits.
stage_two: Declared editorial extracts and explicit path/digest/byte-count rebinding follow the pure substitution stage; see EDITORIAL_LINE_EDITS.json, EDITORIAL_EXTRACTS.json and PATH_REFERENCE_BINDINGS.json.
originals: Private originals are not distributed; no claim of public availability or a new historical execution.
limitation: The build-account name is not printed in the edition. It is not a secret: someone who knows it can recompute the before-hashes. No string-length or digest commitment is published.
